macros.name: addtostream
macros.doc: The command \addtostream{⟨stream⟩}{⟨text⟩} writes ⟨text⟩ to the file currently attached to the output stream ⟨stream⟩, which must be open.

macros.name: closeinputstream
macros.doc: The macro \closeinputstream{⟨stream⟩} calls the macro \atstreamclose<stream>, closes the input stream ⟨stream⟩ and closes whatever file is currently attached to ⟨stream⟩.

macros.name: closeoutputstream
macros.doc: The macro \closeoutputstream{⟨stream⟩} calls the macro \atstreamclose<stream>, closes the output stream ⟨stream⟩ and closes whatever file is currently attached to ⟨stream⟩.

macros.name: marginnumbervstream
macros.doc: \marginnumbervstream puts numbers in the margin at the start of each line read verbatim.

macros.name: newinputstream
macros.doc: The command \newinputstream{⟨stream⟩} creates a new stream for reading from a file.

macros.name: newoutputstream
macros.doc: The command \newoutputstream{⟨stream⟩} creates a new stream called ⟨stream⟩ for writing out text and commands.

macros.name: numbervstream
macros.doc: \numbervstream puts numbers at the start of each line read verbatim.

macros.name: openinputfile
macros.doc: \openinputfile{⟨filename⟩}{⟨stream⟩} opens the file called ⟨filename⟩ and attaches it to the stream ⟨stream⟩ for reading.

macros.name: openoutputfile
macros.doc: \openoutputfile{⟨filename⟩}{⟨stream⟩} opens the file called ⟨filename⟩ and attaches it to the stream ⟨stream⟩ for writing.

macros.name: readaline
macros.doc: The macro \readaline{⟨stream⟩} reads what TeX considers to be one line from the file that is currently associated with the input stream ⟨stream⟩.

macros.name: readstream
macros.doc: The macro \readstream{⟨stream⟩} reads the contents of the file that is currently associated with the input stream ⟨stream⟩.

macros.name: readverbatim
macros.doc: The macro \readverbatim{⟨stream⟩} reads the contents of the file that is currently associated with the input stream ⟨stream⟩ as verbatim text.

macros.name: readverbatim*
macros.doc: The macro \readverbatim{⟨stream⟩} reads the contents of the file that is currently associated with the input stream ⟨stream⟩ as verbatim text.

macros.name: streamvnumfont
macros.doc: The numbers are typeset in the font specified by \streamvnumfont{⟨font⟩}.

envs.name: writeverbatim
envs.doc: \begin{writeverbatim}{⟨stream⟩} writes the contents of the environment as verbatim text to the given ⟨stream⟩.
